'''Kalla''' was a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] during the [[Great Galactic War]].<ref name="Deceived" /> In [[3653 BBY]],<ref name="time1" /> she was present at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] immediately before the [[Sacking of Coruscant|attack]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], and was one of the many [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to fall during the battle.<ref name="Deceived" />
